description.value: A 111-site BC Parks campground on the shores of Moyie Lake, 20 km south of Cranbrook on paved Highway 3/95, with 1,300 m of developed sandy beach, hot showers, and an adventure playground; heavily popular in summer and reservable.

address.value: 3208 Brana Rd, Moyie, BC V1C 6X5, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website confirms Moyie Lake Park is an active 111-site provincial campground 20 km south of Cranbrook on Highway 3/95, matching OSM capacity data. Hot showers are explicitly stated on the park page ('hot showers are on site'), and the BC Parks frontcountry reservation system with a prominent 'Book camping' button confirms reservations are accepted. The OSM phone (+1-250-422-3003) is attributed to operator EK Parks Ltd. and does not appear in the fetched website content, so it cannot be confirmed or contradicted.
concerns: OSM phone (+1-250-422-3003) is attributed to operator EK Parks Ltd. but does not appear in the fetched BC Parks website content; cannot be confirmed or contradicted from available evidence.

Website notes bicycles are 'only permitted on the main section' of the park's nature trails — relevant context for cyclists wishing to use the trail network.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active BC provincial park campground with 111 sites, hot showers, and beach access on the Highway 3/95 touring corridor — a practical and well-equipped overnight destination for cycling tourists in the Kootenay region.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM tags indicate no internet access and no power supply at campsites (internet_access=no, power_supply=no), consistent with a standard BC provincial park setting, but these could not be independently verified from the BC Parks website content.
